title: My First Post

content: I created this site to share what I’ve learned building production Unity systems – architecture decisions, performance deep-dives, and the kind of hard-won details that don’t make it into documentation. If you’re a Unity developer or just curious about how large-scale games and applications are built, you’ll find something useful here.
